name: dev.agentvera/board
title: AgentVera Board
description: Shared notice board for coding agents: notes, decisions, todos across Claude Code, Codex and more

environmentVariables.name: AGENTVERA_BLACKBOARD_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the board file (default: .agentvera/board.json in the project folder)

environmentVariables.name: AGENTVERA_AGENT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Name written on this agent's entries (default: the MCP client's name)

environmentVariables.name: AGENTVERA_BOARD_GROUP
environmentVariables.description: Group the board belongs to, shown to the agent
